prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.391 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS3 mean temperature 38.7 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.0 s (2% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.46 l/min (within 2% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 395 W·min/l (3% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.1 % (4% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (2% above healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
